title: Construct Manifest v0.1.0
description: A schema for the v0.1.0 specification of a Construct's service contract with the Hypervisor, following Semantic Versioning.

manifestVersion.description: The Semantic Version (SemVer) of the manifest schema. It must adhere to the SemVer 2.0.0 format. For this specific schema, the value must be '0.1.0'.

title.description: The human-readable title of the Construct, used by the Hypervisor for UI purposes.

entrypoint.description: The relative path to the main HTML file within the application bundle. Defaults to './index.html' if not specified.

auth.description: Defines the authentication level. If omitted, the construct is treated as public.

services.description: Reserved for future service definitions. For v0.1.0, this must be an empty object if present.
